17343.d: Menaphos, also known as the Golden City, is a city located far south in the Kharidian Desert.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• The Menaphos lodestone teleports players directly to the centre of the city.
• If the Menaphos lodestone hasn't been unlocked yet, players can teleport to the Bandit Camp lodestone, then run south.
• If Pharaoh's Folly is completed, Leela's favour may teleport players to various Menaphos destinations.
• The magic carpet system can be used to travel to the gates of Menaphos.
• The camulet can teleport players to Enakhra's Temple, which is underground just north of Menaphos.
• Players can also travel to Sophanem first. Any forms of transportation that originate within Sophanem require completion of Icthlarin's Little Helper.
• A bridge connects Sophanem and Menaphos, but it is inaccessible from the Sophanem side if the player hasn't completed the quest 'Phite Club.
• Exit Sophanem from the north gate, run north and cross the River Elid, run south, and enter Menaphos through its north gate.
• Alternatively, after exiting Sophanem, take the magic carpet to Pollnivneach, then take another carpet trip to Menaphos.

Imperial district
• The nature's sentinel outfit can teleport players to the acadia trees in the Imperial district.
• The sceptre of the gods can teleport the player directly to the Golden Palace (Jalkabir) in the Imperial district.
• A fairy ring (CKQ) is located near the fountain behind the Golden Palace.

Port district
• The player can speak to Quartermaster Gully on any of the islands in The Arc to return to Menaphos, but only if their starting point was Menaphos.
• The player can use the Captain's Log to teleport to the Player-owned port and then exit the portal to get to the port district, but only if they had visited the Player-owned port via Port district the last time.
• A player-owned house portal is in the Port district, north-east of Kags.
• A charter ship to the north-western dock in the Port district for 1,500 coins.
• Slayer Codex teleport and the boat to Menaphos can be used via Portmaster Kags.

Between districts

Travel between the four districts of Menaphos can be simplified by using a right-click interface on the entrance of the Shifting Tombs found in each district.

Prior to an update on 3 July 2017, a right click would give the option of "Quick travel RSFont | shadow=no | Shifting tombs | color=aqua ". Five options were available including entering the Shifting Tombs and quick travel to the entrance of each district's Shifting Tombs entrance.

17345.d: The Imperial district is the largest district of Menaphos, and contains the Golden Palace.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Use Home Teleport to the Menaphos lodestone and go west to the Imperial district.
• Use a Imperial district teleport to teleport directly into the district.
• The Sceptre of the gods teleports directly into the district.
• Leela's favour, a reward from completing Pharaoh's Folly, teleports directly into the district.
• Any boss portal that directs to Amascut, the Devourer (after Eclipse of the Heart) teleports into the district, next to the Golden Palace.
• The Fairy ring CKQ or soul altar teleport tablet teleports to the far west side of the district.
• The Nature's sentinel outfit can teleport to the acadia trees within the district.
• The skill portal in the Max guild garden, or accessed through grace of the elves, can teleport to the VIP skilling area within the district.
